products.product_description: BDAY CAKE MOCHI CRUNCH packed in pink plastic pouch packaging, net wt. 5oz, UPC 7189147148, Orwaiian LLC, 465 NE Burnside Rd Gresham, OR 97030. The label declares "***Ingredients: Sesame Seeds, Milk Powder, Nonfat dry milk, Soy Lecithin, Coconut ***CONTAINS: Soy, Sesame ***MANUFACTURED in a facility that also processes: MILK ***SOY, SESAME***COCONUT***".
products.code_info: MFG Code: MCBD05. Expiry dates of 07-29-2025 or earlier. MFG Code breakdown as Mochi Crunch B Day 5oz
products.reason_for_recall: Label has a Contains statement that is missing milk and coconut (tree nut) that are declared in the ingredients statement.
